name: Buffer
description: Buffer is a social media tool that helps you plan, write, and schedule posts across all your channels. The Buffer MCP server connects Buffer to AI assistants like Claude, so you can create posts, save ideas, and check how your content is doing just by asking your AI assistant. No switching tabs, no copy-pasting. It works with all the channels you've already connected to Buffer.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Buffer to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Buffer to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.buffer.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Buffer MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Buffer lists 15 MCP tools, including create_idea, create_post, delete_post, edit_post, execute_mutation, execute_query, get_account, get_aggregated_post_metrics, get_channel, get_post, introspect_schema, and list_channels.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Buffer?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Buffer in marketing-seo on the Manufact MCP catalog include Buzzfy, Airefs AI Visibility, TalkGenAI, RankControl, and attentive-mcp-server.
Buffer requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Buffer is developed by Buffer. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
